slides.title: Chrysler Diagnostic Application CDA –
slides.body:
CDA is the
diagnostic tool of
Chrysler; at the
moment FCA is
using this tool on
some projects.
CDA is quite similar
and equivalent to
DIAnalyzer.
Chrysler Diagnostic ApplicationCDA –

slides.title: Chrysler Diagnostic Application CDA –
slides.body:
Any user needs of a
specific enabled ID to use
CDA.
It’s possible to use CDA in
Offline (check «Work
Offline») but it’s necessary
a specific user privilege.

slides.title: Device selection CDA –
slides.body:
The first step to exchange
diagnostic data with CDA
is the selection of the
hardware device: in this
screen it’s necessary
select the device and
press the button Connect.
Pay attention that CDA
can connect itself only to
known hardware; the
hardware needs to be
installed correctly on the
host PC.
Device selectionCDA –

slides.title: Device configuration CDA –
slides.body:
CDA needs to know if the
user is working with a
«Vehicle» or with a
simulated environment
(«Benchtop»)
Channel assignment:
The user has to select the
channel that he want use
to estabilish the diagnostic
communication between
ECU and CDA
Device configurationCDA –

slides.title: ECU selection CDA –
slides.body:
ECU selection.
The user has to select the
ECU for the diagnostic
communication. It’s
necessary scroll, select
and double click on the
selected ECU
ECU selectionCDA –

slides.title: Verification of the ECU connection CDA –
slides.body:
In case of a successfull
connection with the selected
ECU:
o It appears a blu tick near
the selected ECU;
o It appears the message
related the «Identification
successful».
o CDA open the diagnostic
windows of the selected
ECU
o Now it’s possible navigate
among all the diagnostic
windows to manage all
the diagnostic
functionalities
Verification of the ECU connectionCDA –

slides.title: Diagnostic screen CDA – DTC section: check of all DTC information
slides.body:
Diagnostic screenCDA –
Read/Write RDI
IOControl:
Selection and
execution of
active diagnosis
on the actuator.
ROUTINE section:
Selection and
execution of routines
(predefined system
operation on the
ECU)
PID EDITOR section:
It’s possible to send raw
value and read raw
response for the
diagnostic information.
ECU UNLOCK section:
it’s necessary unlock ad
ECU only with a specific
user privilege
CALIBRATION
It’s possible to
send a sequence
of command to
the ECU with a
.txt file

slides.title: Read RDI CDA –
slides.body:
Read RDI :
Vit’s possible
to read an
RDI with an
access to
section
Read/Write
RDI.
With a single
click on the
RDI, it’s
possible to
read the
content.
Read RDICDA –

slides.title: Write RDI CDA – Tasto Write
slides.body:
WriteRDI
It’s possible write on
many RDI; this is an
EEPROM writing
operation. An
example of writing
operation on an RDI
is the PROXI
procedure.
To modify an RDI it’s
possible select the
notepad , modify the
value and press the
button «Write».
If the operation is
successfull, it
appears a message
«Write successfull».
Write RDICDA –

slides.title: Read DTC CDA –
slides.body:
Read a DTC.
In the section DTCs
there’s the list of all DTC
stored in memory.
With the selection of a
DTC it appears all the
information related to the
DTC: snapshot and
extended data record.
The user can compare
the environmental data of
all DTC
For further details on the
DTC it’s possible to
select the gear wheel.
«Clear DTCs» button can
reset the error memory.
It’s possible to clear the
error memory only in
KeyOn condition and not
in engine running.
Read DTCCDA –

slides.title: PID Editor CDA –
slides.body:
PID Editor:
In the PID editor
section, the user can
send a raw request
to the ECU and he
can read the raw
response of the ECU
In the figure, for
example the
technician required
the RDI F1 81.
It’s important that the
user send the raw
data request always
from the row 0.
PID EditorCDA –

slides.title: Flash operation CDA –
slides.body:
FLASH operation:
The user can execute a
software download on the
ECU using the lightning
icon on CDA.
It appears the download
windows.
The user has to select
the file necessary for
flashing with a click on
«Select Flash File» and
with a click on «Start
Flash».
It’s necessary use a .efd
file for the applicative
software on the ECU.
CDA will inform the user
when the flashing
procedure is finished.
Usually the download bar
locks to 99%; to complete
the flash it’s necessary a
KeyOff->KeyOn
procedure.
Flash operationCDA –

slides.title: Write PROXI CDA –
slides.body:
The PROXI procedure
with CDA can execute
only in Vehicle mode;
it’s not possible to
execute in an HiL
bench.
The user has to select
the .byt file
(configuration file) and
he has to exucute the
PROXI procedure.
The user can modify
also the .byt file, but he
needs of a specific
user privilege.
The PROXI procedure
is quite simple in
DIAnalyzer instead of
CDA.
In both cases, the user
need of an user
privilege.
Write PROXICDA –
PROXI button 🡪 CDA open the
first PROXI window and the
date are in raw value.

PROXI data with all

slides.title: Write PROXI CDA –
slides.body:
The user can
execute the
PROXI procedure
also using the
raw data in the
PID Editor
section.
